items.t: No clear trend in pollution-sensitive animals in this region (-0.9 points per decade; 267 surveys at 92 sites, 2017–2026; q = 0.60).
Chloride: of 203 sites with long records here, 47 are rising and 7 falling (seasonal Kendall per site, false discovery rate 5% across all 396 sites tested).
Paved and roofed area went from 2.3% in 1985 to 3.1% in 2025 across 4,696 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

962 of 4,696 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 126 for salt or chloride; 461 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
47 of 4,696 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 137 of 144 high-need ones have none.
